programme.title: Computer Science Undergraduate Matriculated BS - Bachelor of Science
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, School of Engineering
programme.how_found: web search restricted to stanford.edu (discovery only) -> Stanford Bulletin CS-BS; department page www.cs.stanford.edu/bs-degree-requirements.
programme.notes: Owner ruling (US): no CS-specific admissions page; first-year applicants are admitted to the university and declare the major later, so english, deadline, tuition and aid come from the university-wide undergraduate admission and financial aid pages, scoped to the university.

english.quote: Are English proficiency exams required? No, we do not require any English proficiency exams.
english.notes: International applicants FAQ. Scores may be self-reported; 'fluency in English is a prerequisite for admission to Stanford'. ACT or SAT is required for all first-year applicants.

gpa.notes: No minimum GPA is published; holistic review. The Academic Preparation page gives only curriculum recommendations: 'We want to emphasize that these are curriculum recommendations, not requirements.' (https://admission.stanford.edu/apply/first-year/prepare.html).

deadline.quote: Standard Application Deadline - January 5 Common Application Deadline: January 5
deadline.notes: Regular Decision, first-year applicants; the international page says 'The application requirements are the same for all applicants regardless of citizenship'. Submit by 11:59 p.m. in the applicant's local timezone. The date is printed without a year (page updated September 10, 2026, i.e. the cycle for autumn 2027 entry). Restrictive Early Action: November 1.

tuition.notes: Undergraduate student budget, Autumn/Winter/Spring quarters, charged quarterly. 2027-28 not published. Total budget $97,545 including housing and food 22,944 and student fees allowance 2,610.

scholarship_exists.quote: Stanford is committed to meeting demonstrated financial need for all admitted students (regardless of citizenship) who have requested financial aid during the application process. We do not offer merit scholarships outside of a limited number of athletic scholarships.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based aid (grant), sized by a need assessment: NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE. No merit scholarships.

scholarship_international.quote: Financial aid at Stanford is based on the family's demonstrated financial need and we will meet the full need of all admitted students regardless of citizenship.
scholarship_international.notes: Open to international citizens, but need-aware for them: 'For international citizens who indicate on their application that they will be applying for financial aid, that request will be a factor in our admission evaluation, making the process more selective.'
